materials: the ship's look: wood, ochre, rope; sail in the owner's dye

assets.attachmentPoints: GreekShipParts.MastFoot, SailTop; the stem and stern heads (Sheer, Z) for the lines

assets.integration: ShipVisual.Mast.cs (from SetCondition and AnimateSail, not from the water's methods), BattleController.MastEffects (splinters, water column), BattleEffects.ShipFate skips its own mast fall for a mast already down

limitations: oars are not broken afloat; planks fly only as splinters
crew may stand where the fallen mast lies
the sail is drawn even though warships left their large sails ashore (R-SAILS-ASHORE)
